title: Extended Care Health Option (ECHO) Terms of Registration
content:
**Section 1. Eligibility.** The Extended Care Health Option (ECHO) is open only to beneficiaries whose DEERS category is among the eligible beneficiary categories and who have a qualifying condition among the qualifying conditions documented by the case manager. The beneficiary holds an active TRICARE Prime or TRICARE Select enrollment and, where Exceptional Family Member Program enrollment is required, is enrolled in the Exceptional Family Member Program.

**Section 2. Decision and effective date.** A complete registration is decided within the registration review period in business days and takes effect under the registration effective rule; no ECHO benefit is paid for services before the effective date.

**Section 3. Retirees.** Retirees and their family members are not eligible.

The eligible categories, the qualifying conditions, whether Exceptional Family Member Program enrollment is required, the review period and the effective-date rule are the figures and terms of the product's registration requirements schedule.

## Approval condition

A registration is approved only where the beneficiary holds an active TRICARE Prime or TRICARE Select enrollment and, where Exceptional Family Member Program enrollment is required, is enrolled in the Exceptional Family Member Program. This is read, before the approval, from the company's records for the same beneficiary: the beneficiary's TRICARE Prime enrollments and TRICARE Select enrollments and their status, the Exceptional Family Member Program confirmation on the ECHO registration request, and the beneficiary category DEERS shows. A caller's statement does not stand in for those records.

## Course of a registration

- A registration request, once received, is applied; it records the beneficiary, the tier for the sponsor's pay grade, the qualifying condition documented, whether Exceptional Family Member Program enrollment is confirmed, and the date the request was received.
- It becomes registered when the ECHO case manager confirms the qualifying condition, the Exceptional Family Member Program enrollment and the basic TRICARE coverage; the registration takes effect on its effective date.
- It is denied because a registration requirement is not met; the denial date is recorded as its end.

## Approval checklist (every element must hold)

| Element | Evidence on record |
|---|---|
| DEERS category is an eligible beneficiary category | the beneficiary category DEERS shows |
| A qualifying condition documented by the case manager | the qualifying condition on the registration |
| Active TRICARE Prime or TRICARE Select enrollment | the beneficiary's Prime or Select enrollment status |
| Exceptional Family Member Program enrollment, where required | the confirmation on the registration request |
| Not a retiree or a retiree's family member | the beneficiary category DEERS shows |

## Hypothetical cases, for illustration only

| Case | Facts | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Active duty family member, documented qualifying condition, active TRICARE Select enrollment, Exceptional Family Member Program enrollment confirmed | the approval condition holds |
| 2 | As case 1, but no active TRICARE Prime or TRICARE Select enrollment | the approval condition fails; a registration requirement is not met |
| 3 | As case 1, but Exceptional Family Member Program enrollment not confirmed | the approval condition fails |
| 4 | Family member of a retiree | not eligible |
| 5 | Registration approved and in effect from a given date; a service received the day before that date | no ECHO benefit is paid for that service |
